_comment: Central source of truth for per-agent model selection.
Model values use Claude Code's short-form aliases, never dated model IDs.
An alias tracks the current generation, so a model upgrade needs no edit
here and no agent silently pins to a retired version:
- 'opus'    (deep reasoning: planning and final judgment only)
Dated IDs (claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5) belong only in application code
and API examples, where the alias is not a valid model identifier.
Opus is reserved for the design chain — `architect`, `planner`, `judge`.
See CLAUDE.md Agent Routing. Adding a fourth is a cost decision, not a
formatting one: opus runs roughly 15-20x haiku and 3-5x sonnet per token.
Agents not listed here take default.model.
In CI, verify with:  node scripts/sync-agent-models.mjs --check
